optimizedDescription.value: CLI group `specd specs optimizations` get/set/clear lock-owned optimizedDescription/optimizedContext via Kernel; no local freshness/hash logic.

optimizedContext.value:
# cli:spec-optimizations

## Rules

### Command signature
- Persisted opts under `specd specs optimizations`:
  - `specs optimizations get <spec-id> [--field optimizedDescription|optimizedContext]`
  - `specs optimizations set <spec-id> --input <json-file|->`
  - `specs optimizations clear <spec-id> --field optimizedDescription|optimizedContext...`
- Every subcommand: `--format text|json|toon` (default `text`) per `cli:entrypoint`

### Get subcommand
- MUST call `Kernel.specs.getPersistedOptimizations` w/ optional `field`; print value + freshness + staleness reasons
- Text: mark stale as `STALE` + reasons (`artifact-added`, `artifact-removed`, `artifact-changed`, `schema-changed`)
- JSON/TOON: full per-field freshness + aggregate `fresh` from use case unchanged
- No persisted state → report not yet initialized
- Absent requested field → report missing, not error

### Set subcommand
- MUST read JSON from file path, or stdin when `--input -`
- Parse as object; keys ⊂ `{optimizedDescription, optimizedContext}` w/ string values; reject other shapes at CLI w/ `error:` before Core
- On success: `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations` w/ `set` = parsed object; print resulting values

### Clear subcommand
- MUST call `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations` w/ `clear` = supplied field names; print result (may be empty)

### No repeated CLI-owned mutation or freshness logic
- Handlers MUST NOT compute artifact hashes, staleness reasons, or baseline capture; MUST NOT write persisted state directly
- Every read/mutation = one call to `Kernel.specs.getPersistedOptimizations` or `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations`; flags map onto typed input

### Error mapping
- `SpecNotFoundError` → exit 1, `error:` naming unresolved spec
- Invalid `--input` JSON → exit 1, `error: invalid JSON: <message>` before Core
- `ArtifactConflictError` → exit 1, concurrent modification + retry
- `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` → exit 1, no configuration workaround suggestion

## Constraints
- Never read/write spec-lock.json directly — only via `Kernel.specs.getPersistedOptimizations` / `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations`
- Never invoke LLM; never decide if optimization should run; `llmOptimizedContext` gate is caller-owned (skill/agent)
- `specs optimizations set` = sole persist entry; no write-metadata equivalent for optimizations
- Every leaf subcommand: `.allowExcessArguments(false)`
